name: squish-memory
description: Persistent memory system for AI agents with auto-capture, context injection, and cross-session recall

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory persistence and context injection
interface.longDescription: Squish provides universal long-term memory for AI agents. It auto-captures session context, enables cross-session recall, and injects relevant memories into your conversations. Memory persists across projects, sessions, and even different AI assistants.
